skills.name: Plan a London walking tour and hunt cheap flights
skills.prompt: Plan a self-guided walking tour of [city] for [number] hours, starting at [location], with stops, walking times and opening hours in a clear itinerary. Then search flights from [origin] within [date windows] and list the three cheapest options. Draft, but do not send, an email to [person] with the plan, and show it to me for review.
skills.summary: The author used Comet as default browser for a month to plan a walking tour, search flights in set windows and draft emails, noting where it struggled.

skills.name: Plan a birthday evening with dinner and a comedy show
skills.prompt: Plan a birthday evening for my [partner's name] on [date] in [city]: dinner at a [cuisine] restaurant near [area] followed by a [comedy show or other event]. Ask me about any location details you need, then find options that fit [budget] and a sensible timeline between dinner and the show. Before you book the table or buy two tickets, show me exactly what you're about to purchase and wait for my approval.
skills.summary: Muse agent planned a wife's birthday evening, booking dinner and buying two tickets with permission after refining location details.

skills.name: Plan a family Christmas trip and book flights
skills.prompt: Plan a family Christmas trip to [destination] for [number of people] from [dates], with a total budget of [amount]. Find the best flights on [airline] and suggest lodging and a simple daily plan. Show me the flights, prices and itinerary before booking or paying, and send me the final plan once confirmed.
skills.summary: The user has Muse handle budgeting and fitness goals, and it booked Southwest flights and planned the whole family Christmas trip.

skills.name: Plan a family trip and pre-fill bookings
skills.prompt: Plan a [number]-day family trip to [destination] for [number] people, [dates], with a budget of about [amount]. Search flights, compare three hotels, and build a day-by-day itinerary suited to [ages or interests]. Pre-fill the booking forms for my chosen options, but stop and show me everything before any payment or final submission.
skills.summary: A reporter had ChatGPT Agent plan a 4-day San Diego trip: it searched flights, compared hotels, built an itinerary and pre-filled booking forms, stopping before purchase.

skills.name: Plan a group weekend trip and make reservations
skills.prompt: Plan a long weekend trip for [number] friends in [destination] from [dates], with a budget of about [amount] per person. Build a simple shared page with 2 or 3 itinerary options and a way for everyone to vote, then draft an email to the group in Gmail. Pause and show me the email and any reservation details before sending anything or booking or paying for anything.
skills.summary: ChatGPT work mode planned a long weekend for 9 friends, built a coordination site, reached group agreement, made reservations, and drafted a Gmail email.

skills.name: Plan a last-minute business trip by phone
skills.prompt: I need to travel to [city] for [purpose] on [date], returning [date]. Find refundable flights and hotels near [location] that fit this policy: [budget, cabin class, rules]. Give me your top two options with prices, and prepare the booking but pause for my approval before paying.
skills.summary: In OpenAI's demo, a Dot found a refundable policy-compliant flight and hotel options and prepared a booking, though the flight was still pending at the end.

skills.name: Plan a road trip with Claude Cowork
skills.prompt: I'm planning a road trip from [starting city] to [destination] on [dates]. Compare two or three driving routes and give me drive times, toll costs, good stops for gas and food roughly every [number] hours, and parking options near [hotel or destination]. Finish with a one-page day-by-day plan saved as a document, and don't book or pay for anything.
skills.summary: The poster used Claude for the entire planning of a trip to National Harbor, MD, with it acting like a knowledgeable companion on routes.

skills.name: Plan a trip and book flight, hotel and shuttle with an always-on agent
skills.prompt: Plan a trip to [destination] from [date] to [date] for [number] travelers with a budget of [amount]. Find flight, hotel, and airport shuttle options, give me a short comparison, and remind me on [day] to book the shuttle. Fill in booking forms as far as you can, but pause and show me everything before any payment or submission, and tell me exactly what you need from me for 2FA steps.
skills.summary: A user had Dots plan a trip and remind them to book the shuttle; the agent filled booking forms but kept asking for confirmation and wouldn't enter 2FA codes, so it only got partway.

skills.name: Plan a vacation with a custom Codex-built website
skills.prompt: Plan a trip to [destination] for [dates] with a budget of [amount] and preferences like [hotel style, must-see things]. Research hotels, plot them on a Google Map, and build a simple trip website that you deploy to [hosting option]. Stop at the booking or checkout page for anything and show me the details before I confirm; do not pay or submit anything yourself.
skills.summary: Claire had Codex research hotels, map them on Google Maps and deploy a trip site from her phone; its browser also navigated to checkout for an item.

skills.name: Plan and book a movie date night
skills.prompt: Plan a movie date night for [date] in [city]: find showtimes for [movie or genre] around [time] at [theater], and pick two good seats together. Stop and let me enter payment details myself, and show me the full order summary before you buy anything. After I confirm, add the showtime to my calendar and invite [partner's email].
skills.summary: ChatGPT Agent picked seats on a theater site, paused for payment details, bought tickets after confirmation, and created a calendar event.

skills.name: Plan and book a short-notice work trip
skills.prompt: I need a work trip to [destination] on [dates] at short notice, arriving by [time]. Research flights on [booking site], shortlist three options with price and times, and wait for my pick. Then fill in the booking form using my details and stop at the payment step so I can review everything before paying.
skills.summary: Grok Bot researched flights and booked the one Vince picked, though he had to take over the computer to fill in data and found it harder than booking himself.

skills.name: Plan business trips and learn from each debrief
skills.prompt: Plan a business trip to [destination] from [date] to [date], departing from [city]. Search flights and hotels, apply my preferences in [seat, airline, hotel chain, budget, neighborhood], and give me one recommendation with a price breakdown and one backup. Do not book anything; wait for my approval, and after the trip ask for a debrief and save what you learned to memory.
skills.summary: A demo travel-ops agent searched flights and hotels, applied stored preferences and produced one recommendation pending approval, then updated its memory; nothing was booked.

skills.name: Plan business trips by voice message in Telegram
skills.prompt: Build an n8n workflow where I send a Telegram voice note like 'I need to be in [city] from [date] to [date], hotel near [area]'. It should transcribe the audio, extract destination, dates and lodging needs, then search flights and hotels using [my preferred search API]. It's done when it replies in Telegram with the top 3 options of each; never book anything, only present choices.
skills.summary: An n8n workflow transcribes Telegram voice notes, extracts destinations, dates and lodging needs, and searches flights and hotels for business travel.

skills.name: Plan family vacations with Deep Research
skills.prompt: Plan a [number]-day family trip for [number] adults and [kids' ages] in [month or season], with a budget of [amount] and a departure from [city]. Suggest [number] destinations, then for my favorite, build a day-by-day schedule of attractions and a shortlist of places to stay with prices and links. Stop at the shortlist, and do not book anything.
skills.summary: Author uses ChatGPT Deep Research with detailed family prompts to find destinations, attractions and schedule trips; it can't yet filter and book accommodation.

skills.name: Plan vacations, handle visas and make bookings
skills.prompt: Plan a [number]-day trip to [destination] for [number] travelers from [departure city] between [date range], with a budget of [amount]. Check the visa requirements for my [nationality] passport, list the documents and steps I need, and find flight and hotel options that fit. Finish with a day-by-day itinerary and a shortlist of bookings, and pause to show me the details before paying for anything or submitting any visa form.
skills.summary: Uses AI to plan vacations, handle visas and do all the bookings; the post also mentions AI filtering dating outreach.

skills.name: Rebook a delayed flight connection mid-flight
skills.prompt: My flight [airline and flight number] is delayed and I may miss my connection at [connecting airport]. Contact [airlines involved] through their chat support, find the best free rebooking option to reach [final destination], and show me the new itinerary and any fees before you confirm anything. Once I approve and the rebooking is confirmed, email me the new details.
skills.summary: OpenAI's Dot chatted with Alaska, Delta and KLM, found a new route and rebooked Denis for free after he approved, while he was still on the plane.

skills.name: Rebook a work flight to save money
skills.prompt: Look at my booked flight [airline, confirmation code, route, date] and check for cheaper options on the same route and similar times, including rebooking fees and fare differences. Summarize the net savings. Pause and show me the exact change and cost before you rebook or pay anything.
skills.summary: Arden texted a user that rebooking his Zurich flight would save $7,750; after he approved, it changed the flight and the refund hit his corporate card.

skills.name: Rebook after a flight cancellation
skills.prompt: My flight [flight number] on [date] from [origin] to [destination] was cancelled. Find replacement flight options that get me there by [deadline], and a rental car at [destination] if needed. Put everything into one summary with times, prices, and confirmation steps. Pause and show me the choices before booking or paying for anything.
skills.summary: ChatGPT Work mode found replacement flights, arranged a rental car, and consolidated the new travel arrangements after a cancellation.

skills.name: Recommend a hotel from client notes using Codex
skills.prompt: Here are my notes on a client: [paste notes on preferences, budget, travel dates, and must-haves]. Recommend one hotel in [destination] that fits, checking live booking sites for availability and rates on [dates]. Finish with a Word document covering the recommendation, why it fits, rates found, and two alternates. Don't book anything or contact anyone.
skills.summary: A travel advisor had Codex use client notes to recommend a Belmond hotel in Italy, checking live booking engines and generating a detailed Word doc.

skills.name: Reprice booked flights when prices drop
skills.prompt: I've booked a flight with [airline] under confirmation code [code]. Check the airline's site today for the current price on the same flights and tell me whether it's lower than what I paid ([amount]). If it is, show me the refund or rebooking options and what each would cost or credit me, and pause for my approval before changing or submitting anything.
skills.summary: An AI agent monitors flight prices after booking and processes refunds when fares fall; the poster says it repriced their ticket multiple times.

skills.name: Research and help rebook a flight with an always-on agent
skills.prompt: I need to change my flight from [origin] to [destination] on [date]. Research the best alternative flights for [new date/time window] and check them against my calendar and anything in [Slack channel] that might clash, like [meeting or recording]. Give me a short comparison with any conflicts flagged, and pause for my approval before booking, paying, or contacting the airline.
skills.summary: An Every writer's Dot researched a flight change and flagged a clash with a colleague's recording, learned from a Slack discussion.

skills.name: Research hotels and pull tax documents with Chrome auto browse
skills.prompt: In Chrome, research [number] hotels in [city] for [dates] across [two or three booking sites], and give me a comparison table with price, location, rating and cancellation terms. Then log into [portal] and download my [document type, e.g. tax documents] for [year], listing what you saved. Stop and ask me before any login step, purchase or order.
skills.summary: A tester used Gemini in Chrome to research Lisbon hotels across sites and fetch tax documents from payroll portals; it stopped before placing a grocery order.

skills.name: Research hotels for a 14-day Japan trip
skills.prompt: I'm taking a [number]-day trip to [country] visiting [cities and dates]. For each city, search Booking.com for well-rated hotels within [budget] per night, cross-check recent reviews and distance to the nearest station, and give me three options per city with price, rating, and a pro/con line. Don't book anything; end with a comparison table.
skills.summary: Manus searched Booking.com for well-rated hotels, cross-checked reviews and transit, and returned three options per city; the author rated it 7/10 on availability handling.

skills.name: Research restaurants and hotel availability for trips
skills.prompt: I'm planning a trip to [city or country] from [dates]. Find [number] well-reviewed restaurants in [style, e.g. Michelin-starred] and check hotel availability for [number] guests in [area] within [budget]. Give me a short comparison table with prices and booking links, and do not book anything.
skills.summary: A writer used Comet to browse Michelin restaurants for Copenhagen, check Japan hotel availability, and look for deals.

skills.name: Reserve a restaurant table through OpenTable
skills.prompt: Book a table for [number] people at [restaurant name] in [city] on [date] at [time] using OpenTable. Double-check the city and location before searching, and if that time is unavailable, show me the closest options. Pause and show me the reservation details for approval before you confirm.
skills.summary: In a demo, Operator booked a 7 p.m. table at Beretta in San Francisco via OpenTable, first searching the wrong region before correcting and asking for approval.

skills.name: Resolve a declined flight payment from email
skills.prompt: Search my email for a declined payment on my [flight/booking] and find any recent email about my new [debit or credit card]. Tell me what failed and what you plan to do, and pause for my approval before entering any payment details or confirming payment. Once it's paid, add the trip to my calendar with the dates and times and show me the final result.
skills.summary: With email access, Meta Muse spotted a declined flight payment, found the new debit card email, confirmed payment, and added the flight to the calendar.

skills.name: Run a restaurant voice assistant for reservations and orders
skills.prompt: Build me an n8n workflow that acts as the backend for a voice assistant at [my restaurant name]. It should receive webhook requests from [ElevenLabs or Vapi] to check table availability in [my Google Calendar or Sheet], create or cancel reservations, take orders, and log callback requests. It's finished when I can test each action with a sample request and see the result; before it sends any confirmation message or changes real bookings, pause and show me what it will do.
skills.summary: n8n backends let an ElevenLabs voice agent check tables, manage reservations, take orders and request callbacks, plus Vapi travel and home-service booking agents.

skills.name: Save the best local restaurants as a Google Maps list
skills.prompt: I'm visiting [city or neighborhood] from [dates]. Find 10 well-reviewed local restaurants that fit [cuisine, budget, dietary needs], then create a Google Maps list called [list name] and save each one with a note on its signature dish. Pause and let me log in to Google when needed, and finish by showing me the list link and why you chose each place.
skills.summary: Before a vacation, ChatGPT agent picked 10 restaurants, paused for his Google login, then saved a Maps list with signature-dish notes in about 23 minutes.

skills.name: Schedule clinic appointments by phone with an AI agent
skills.prompt: Help me schedule an appointment at [clinic name] for [type of visit] on [preferred days and times]. Find the booking option or phone number, and tell me the earliest slots available. Before you confirm or submit anything, pause and show me the date, time and details.
skills.summary: A clinic's automated phone AI handled the poster's appointment booking call instead of a human.

skills.name: Search flights with airline constraints using Comet
skills.prompt: Search flights from [origin] to [destination] departing between [date range], using only [airlines], with a maximum of [number] stop(s) and no [aircraft type]. Show me the three best options with live prices, durations and layovers in a table. Take me to the passenger info page for my favorite, then stop before entering personal details or paying.
skills.summary: Comet searched Lisbon-to-Taiwan flights across chosen airlines with no 737 Max and one stop max, pulling live prices and reaching the passenger info page.

skills.name: Search for a wedding flight to New York
skills.prompt: Find me specific flights from [departure city] to [destination city] arriving by [date], returning [date], for [number] travelers. Compare at least three options with airline, times, total price and a direct booking link, not just aggregator homepages. Stop at the booking page and show me the options; do not enter payment details or book anything.
skills.summary: The author gave Comet and ChatGPT Atlas the same flight-booking task; Comet mostly pointed to aggregators instead of specific flights.

skills.name: Search for cheap round-trip flights from JFK
skills.prompt: Search for cheap round-trip flights from [home airport] to [destination or list of destinations] for travel between [date range] lasting [number] days. Build a table of the cheapest date and price for each destination, with a direct booking link for each. Do not book anything; I will review the table first.
skills.summary: ChatGPT agent returned a table of dates and prices per destination that matched on checking, but gave no booking links so the reporter had to search manually.

skills.name: Search rentals and book apartment tours in a chat assistant
skills.prompt: Search live rental listings in [city or neighborhood] with a budget of [max rent], [bedrooms] bedrooms, and must-haves of [pets, parking, laundry, etc.]. Give me the best five with price, address, and a link, then propose tour times on [days I'm free] for my top two. Before booking any tour or submitting my contact details, pause and show me what you're about to send.
skills.summary: A how-to describes using Zillow Rentals inside Gemini and ChatGPT to get filtered live listings and book a tour time; it is a guide, not a completed tour.

skills.name: Search venue sites for concerts to attend
skills.prompt: Look at the websites of [venue 1], [venue 2] and [venue 3] in [city] and find [type of event, e.g. classical concerts] happening between [start date] and [end date]. List each with date, venue, ticket price and link, and tell me if a site blocked you. Stop at the list and do not buy tickets.
skills.summary: The author had Operator look for classical concerts in Berlin; it returned a result after 15 minutes but struggled to navigate, and product research and Gmail receipt fetching failed.

skills.name: Send travel checklists and welcome-back messages
skills.prompt: Build an n8n workflow that reads my [Google Sheet of daily trips] each morning. For trips departing in 3 days, send the traveler a WhatsApp packing and documents checklist, and for trips that ended yesterday, send a welcome-back message asking for [feedback]. Do a test run that shows me the messages it would send to [test number] and wait for my okay before enabling live sends.
skills.summary: An n8n workflow scans a travel agency's daily trip sheet and sends WhatsApp checklists 3 days before departure and welcome-back messages a day after return.

skills.name: Shop hotel sites for a New York stay
skills.prompt: Search hotel sites for a stay in [city] from [check-in date] to [check-out date], at [min price] to [max price] per night, near [neighborhood or landmark]. Compare at least three sites and give me a table of the top five options with price, location, rating, cancellation terms and total cost with fees. Stop before booking and ask me which one I want.
skills.summary: In a Skift test, Muse opened a browser and searched hotels for Nov 1-2 at $350-450 a night, suggesting the Marlton Hotel first.

skills.name: Shortlist business-trip hotels into a Google Sheet
skills.prompt: Search Booking.com for hotels near [location] under [price cap] per night, and log each match into a Google Sheet with price, rating, distance from downtown, amenities and the booking link. Stop once you have a shortlist of at least [number] options for me to review.
skills.summary: A Claude in Chrome shortcut searches Booking.com for hotels near downtown under a price cap and logs each with price, rating, distance, amenities and booking link in a Google Sheet.

skills.name: Shortlist destinations and compare stays
skills.prompt: Shortlist [number] sunny destinations in [month] within [number] hours flight of [home city]. For my top [2-3] picks, pull listings from Airbnb and Booking.com for [dates] and [number of guests] under [budget], and put them in a comparison table with price, rating, and location. Do not book anything; stop once the table is ready.
skills.summary: Comet shortlisted sunny destinations by flight time from Amsterdam, then pulled Airbnb and Booking.com listings into a comparison table.

skills.name: Track Las Vegas flight prices and find return flights
skills.prompt: Every morning, check flight prices from [origin city] to [destination] for [dates] and message me a short summary of the cheapest fares. Also find return options to [home airport], keeping to my preferences: [preferred airlines, time of day, max stops, budget]. Give me at least five options with prices and links, flag any price drop of more than [amount], and do not book anything without asking me first.
skills.summary: The author asked Muse to check Vegas fares daily and find returns to San Diego; it gave only three options and ignored his preferences, so he found it underwhelming.

skills.name: Try to book a Warsaw to London trip with Claude
skills.prompt: Build me a small travel planning project for a trip from [origin city] to [destination city] on [dates]. It should pull flight and hotel options from [sites or APIs you prefer] into one ranked comparison file using my budget of [amount] and preferences of [preferences]. Stop once the shortlist is ready and show me the top choices with links, and don't book or pay for anything.
skills.summary: The poster tried to have Claude fully book flights and hotel via Expedia and Kiwi connectors, found them poor, and ended up building a travel booking project instead.

skills.name: Turn reservation calls into calendar bookings
skills.prompt: Build an n8n workflow that receives call transcripts from [Vapi or my voice-agent tool], extracts the guest name, phone number, date, time and party size, and creates a Google Calendar event on [my calendar]. It should also log each booking to a Google Sheet and draft a follow-up message. It's done when a sample transcript produces a calendar event and a sheet row; pause and show me the follow-up before anything is sent.
skills.summary: An n8n workflow takes Vapi call transcripts, extracts reservation details, creates Calendar events, logs to Sheets and sends follow-ups.

skills.name: Watch a ticket site and report available times
skills.prompt: Check [ticket website URL] every [interval] for [show or event] tickets, and tell me as soon as new dates or times appear, with the times, prices and a link. Don't buy anything or submit any forms. Keep watching until [end date] or until I tell you to stop.
skills.summary: Mika Reyes set a Grok Bot routine to keep checking a Dancing with the Stars ticket website and come back with times.
